manifest.name: dsh-voice-dialog
manifest.description: Voice dialog for DeepSeek Harness: multi-speaker ASR, priority queuing, auto-read replies

bundle.text:
# dsh-voice-dialog bundle: continuous voice dialog + auto-read assistant replies.
#
# The host speech stack is composed here so this plugin does not need the
# built-in voice-input bundle (and its one-shot microphone UI) to be enabled.
# If that bundle is already active, disable it first: it declares the same
# three host rows below.
- insert:
    - id: speech-to-text
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-speech-to-text'
      config:
        defaultProvider: sensevoice-local
    - id: speech-to-text-sensevoice
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-speech-to-text-sensevoice'
      config:
        dataRoot: !!js dshHomePath('speech-to-text', 'sensevoice')
    - id: api-speech-to-text
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-api-speech-to-text'
    - id: voice-dialog
      name: dsh-voice-dialog

readme.text: Continuous voice conversation for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): one microphone in the composer, read-aloud while voice input is active, model-controlled voice intents, and soft interruptions that are handed to the running model instead of hard-cancelling it.

- **One microphone, no mode button.** The composer microphone starts and stops continuous listening. There is no floating panel and no second toolbar control. While listening, the left close button stops listening but lets the current read-aloud finish; the square hang-up button also interrupts playback and cancels sentences still being synthesized on the host.
- **Continuous dictation.** A small VAD closes an utterance after ~1.4 s of silence and transcribes it through DSH speech-to-text. With simultaneous-speech separation enabled, the endpoint is tracked per separated source: your lane closes after its own 1.6 s of silence even while someone next to you keeps talking. Speech from the enrolled owner is sent with `session.prompt(..., "queue")` by default, so it waits for the current reply; a setting switches it to `steer` for immediate barge-in. Other speakers are queued by default. Up to three utterances are transcribed in parallel; recognition is parallel, while delivery is one strict FIFO queue in speaking order. The microphone opening threshold is adjustable, so quiet speech can trigger sooner while a noisy room can be made less sensitive.
- **Read-aloud while listening.** The

- DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` or a compatible build.
- Node.js 22+ (DSH requirement).
- A working DSH speech-to-text provider. This bundle composes the host rows itself:
  `speech-to-text`, `speech-to-text-sensevoice`, `api-speech-to-text`.
- Network access to Microsoft Edge TTS for the selected voice; without it, read-aloud falls back to the browser's system voice. The first SenseVoice use may need a model download. When Edge needs a proxy, the plugin reads `HTTPS_PROXY` / `HTTP_PROXY` and tunnels the WebSocket with CONNECT; `DSH_VOICE_TTS_PROXY` overrides it and `NO_PROXY` can exempt Edge.
- A secure browser context for the microphone: `https://` or `http://localhost` / `http://127.0.0.1`.
- Optional speaker labels: `sherpa-onnx-node` (installed as an optional dependency; it resolves a prebuilt native addon for this platform) and a one-time ~27 MB CAM++ model download. Without them, voice input still works, just without speaker labels.
- Optional simultaneous-speech separation: `onnxruntime-node` plus a one-time ~234 MB MossFormer2 model download (an ONNX export of Alibaba's `MossFormer2_SS_16K`, Apache-2.0). DirectML is tried first (about 0.4 s per 4 s window on a supported GPU); CPU is th

From GitHub (the built `lib/` is committed):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ggfgfgf-on/dsh-voice-dialog
```

Or from a local checkout:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add file:D:/path/to/dsh-voice-dialog
```

Then make sure the bundle is listed in the profile manifest:

```json
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ "...", "dsh-voice-dialog" ] } }
```

readme.section: Important: disable the built-in voice-input bundle
readme.text:
This plugin owns the same three speech host rows as
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle`. Do **not** enable both in one
profile; they would register the same services twice. Remove the built-in bundle
from `dsh.profile.bundles` (or disable it in the Plugins page) before enabling
`dsh-voice-dialog`. The microphone UI is replaced by this plugin, so nothing is lost.

1. Open a conversation and click the microphone in the composer.
2. Speak normally. Pauses close an utterance and insert it into the running turn.
3. Assistant replies are read aloud automatically while the microphone is listening.
4. Click the red microphone to stop listening; queued audio finishes and new sentences are not read. The left close button stops listening while queued audio finishes. The square hang-up button also interrupts the current reading and cancels old sentences still queued on the host. Spoken commands such as “轻一点”, “重复一遍” or “别说了” are routed to the model, which calls `voice_dialog`.
If the speech model is not prepared, the microphone opens this plugin page so you can download/prepare it. The page also shows the live provider state and download progress.

| Setting | Storage | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Auto-read, volume, duck level, input device | Browser `localStorage` | Per browser/device |
| Edge TTS voice, speech rate | Host `~/.dsh/voice-dialog/settings.json` | Applies immediately; survives restart |
| ASR provider, language | DSH speech selection | Shared with other speech clients |
| Model preparation | DSH speech host | Download / cancel / retry |
| Speech rate | Host `~/.dsh/voice-dialog/settings.json` | -50%..+50%; the model can change it too |
| Speaker prefix, only-my-voice, threshold | Browser `localStorage` | Prefix / gate behavior |
| Owner delivery, guest interjection policy, parallel organizer, parallel ASR | Browser `localStorage` | Owner queues by default (or steers); guests queue (default), steer, or ignore; up to 3 ASR lanes, strict FIFO delivery; the organizer can override only the current entry's mode |
| Owner + named guest voiceprints | Host `~/.dsh/voice-dialog/voiceprint.json` | Embeddings only; original audio is not stored; up to 12 named guests |
| Voiceprint model | Host `~/.dsh/voice-dialog/models/` | Downloaded from the settings page |
| Simultaneous-speech separation | Browser `localStorage` + ho

The voice selector includes Mandarin, Cantonese, Taiwanese, English and Japanese Edge voices. **Audition** synthesizes a short sample through the host without touching the live reply queue; if Edge is unavailable it reads the sample with the system voice and shows a notice.

```text
llm/stream ──filter(purpose, text-delta)──► SentenceSegmenter ──► TtsQueue(Edge) ──► SSE
                                                                                   ▲
subagent/end ──parent voice-state──► summary ───────────────────────────────────────┘
                                                                                   │

- The host never reads reasoning, tool arguments, compaction summaries or session titles.
- A reply is **not** cancelled on barge-in by default. Only playback gain is ducked. Owner and guest speech share one FIFO queue in speaking order, so a faster ASR result cannot overtake an earlier utterance. A versioned organizer plan may mark the new owner entry as `steer` and fade the current sentence; an explicit “打断” command still cancels the organizer, stops playback and clears the unsent queue.
- The generated speech Remote contribution is vendored in `src/speech-remote.js`, so the client does not need the built-in voice-input UI module to mount it.

- Audio is transcribed by the configured DSH provider. With the default SenseVoice provider it stays on this machine.
- Only the final sentence text is sent to Microsoft Edge TTS for read-aloud.
- The parallel organizer sends the current transcript plus playing/queued flags to the configured DSH provider; it never receives the full conversation history.
- Speaker verification and simultaneous-speech separation run on the local host. The browser sends the short segment to `127.0.0.1`; the host stores only the 192-dimensional embedding (no audio) and never sends it to a cloud service. Separated streams exist only in memory for the current request. Other speakers are clustered in memory for the current session and are not persisted.
- Browser preferences stay in `localStorage`; the voice id is stored under `~/.dsh/voice-dialog/settings.json`. No API keys are used.

- **Microphone error / no permission**: use HTTPS or localhost. On Android Edge you can temporarily allow an insecure origin via `edge://flags/#unsafely-treat-insecure-origin-as-secure`.
- **No sound**: click once anywhere on the page to unlock Web Audio; check the auto-read toggle and volume.
- **Voice preview fails / `read ECONNRESET` in the log**: direct egress to `speech.platform.bing.com` is usually being reset. Set `HTTPS_PROXY` and restart DSH; the host log then prints `Edge TTS via proxy http://…`.
- **Settings page says speech service unavailable**: both voice bundles may be enabled, or the host rows did not mount. Keep only `dsh-voice-dialog`.
- **Model not ready**: open the plugin page and click **准备语音模型**.
- **Speaker labels missing**: open the plugin page, check that the voiceprint model is ready, then click **录制我的声纹**. If the native component is missing, run `pnpm add sherpa-onnx-node` in the profile and restart DSH.
- **The owner is labeled as a guest**: lower the voiceprint threshold slightly (0.52 is a good start), or re-record the voiceprint in a quieter place.

`npm run build` creates the host ESM bundle, the client `__ModuleLoader__` closure, and plain-node test surfaces. `npm test` covers strict FIFO delivery, queue-aware voice commands, sentence segmentation, Markdown filtering, the no-CoT filter, WAV encoding, voice switching, the voiceprint WAV decoder/cosine helper, the separation window/overlap logic, and continuous per-source 1.6 s endpointing with onset-order FIFO, all with injected runners. The native voiceprint and separation models are exercised separately in development; they are not downloaded by `npm test`.

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的连续语音对话插件：输入框旁只有一个麦克风，语音输入期间朗读助手回复，支持模型响应“轻一点/重复/闭嘴”等语音意图；插话会以“软打断”的方式交给正在运行的模型，而不是硬切断回答。

- **只有一个麦克风。** 不再有“电话模式”按钮、悬浮面板或第二套工具栏控件；点麦克风开始/结束连续收音；激活后展开行左边是叉，只关收音、让当前朗读继续；右边方块是挂断，会同时打断朗读并取消后台还没合成的句子。
- **连续听写。** 静音约 1.4 秒后自动结束一句，调用 DSH 语音识别转写。登记过的本人默认用 `session.prompt(..., "queue")` 排在当前回答之后；可以在设置里改成 `steer` 立即插话。其他人默认也走排队。最多三句同时识别；识别是并行的，投递严格按说话先后排一条队列，后来的话不会抢到前面。麦克风触发门槛可以调：小声说话容易漏就调低，环境太吵容易误触发就调高。
- **只在语音输入时朗读。** Host 监听 `llm/stream`，把助手文本按句切分后用 Edge TTS 合成，通过 SSE 推给浏览器排队播放。第一句比较长时，会在第一个自然逗号处先开始合成，不必等整句句号。麦克风启动才接收新句子；关闭麦克风后不再读新内容，但会把已经排队的剩余音频读完。Edge 端点不可达时，这一句会退到系统语音朗读，不会静默消失。
- **按优先级插话。** 你开口时只把朗读音量压低，不停止播放。本人的话默认等当前回答说完，再用 `session.prompt(..., "queue")` 交给模型，不会把你正在听的回答截断；设置里可以改成 `steer` 立即插话。旁边其他人的话也按说话顺序排队，不抢当前回答；也可以改成直接插话或忽略。
- **并行语音组织层。** 助手还在朗读时，主人的新话会立刻入队，但停在队头等一个独立的、带版本号的模型判断：打断、排队还是忽略。打断会先用 250 毫秒淡出当前句、清掉没读的旧句子，再把这句按 `steer` 送进去；排队保持原策略；忽略只丢这一条。判断过期、超时、输出不合法或找不到模型时一律按排队处理。明确说“打断”会取消正在进行的组织判断，仍然优先。组织调用使用 `voice-organizer` 这个 purpose，不会被朗读。
- **队列里的最新意图。** 最新一句说“打断 / 停一下”会立刻停朗读、清掉还没送出的队列，并把后面的请求用插话送进去；说“忽略客人1 / 别理老婆”会当场改声纹策略，把那个人还在排队的句子删掉；说“恢复”重新排队。普通句子仍然严格按先后顺序走，不会因为识别快就超车。
- **不整段读思维链。** 通过 `GenerateOptions.purpose` 过滤 compaction / 会话标题 / voice-organizer 等内部调用；reasoning 只扫描显式的 `[[voice: ...]]` 指令，不会把整段思维链读出来。工具参数永远不会进入 TTS。
- **模型决定说什么、说多快。** 模型可以在 reasoning

- DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 或兼容版本。
- Node.js 22+。
- DSH 语音识别服务。本插件的 bundle 自己组合了三条 host 行：`speech-to-text`、`speech-to-text-sensevoice`、`api-speech-to-text`。
- 朗读需要能访问 Microsoft Edge TTS（用于所选音色）；访问不了会自动退到浏览器系统语音。首次使用 SenseVoice 可能需要下载模型。
- 需要代理才能访问 Edge 时，插件自动读取 `HTTPS_PROXY` / `HTTP_PROXY`，WebSocket 通过 CONNECT 隧道；可用 `DSH_VOICE_TTS_PROXY` 覆盖，`NO_PROXY` 可让 Edge 直连。
- 麦克风需要安全上下文：`https://` 或 `http://localhost` / `http://127.0.0.1`。
- 声纹前缀可选：`sherpa-onnx-node`（可选依赖，自带当前平台的原生模块）和一次约 27 MB 的 CAM++ 模型下载。没有它们时语音输入仍可用，只是不带说话人前缀。
- 同时说话分离可选：`onnxruntime-node` 和一次约 234 MB 的 MossFormer2 模型下载（阿里 `MossFormer2_SS_16K` 的 ONNX 导出，Apache-2.0）。优先用 DirectML（有可用显卡时每 4 秒窗口约 0.4 秒），失败自动回退到处理器。没有它时普通听写不受影响。

从 GitHub 安装（仓库内已提交构建后的 `lib/`）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ggfgfgf-on/dsh-voice-dialog
```

或从本地目录安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add file:D:/path/to/dsh-voice-dialog
```

确认 profile 的 bundle 列表包含：

```json
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ "...", "dsh-voice-dialog" ] } }
```

readme.section: 重要：不要同时启用内置语音输入 bundle
readme.text:
本插件和 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle` 需要同样的三条语音 host 行。
同一个 profile 里同时启用会重复注册服务。请在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里移除内置
语音输入 bundle（或在插件页停用它），只保留 `dsh-voice-dialog`。麦克风界面由本插件接管，功能不会少。

1. 打开会话，点输入框右侧的麦克风。
2. 正常说话；停顿会自动结束一句并插入当前轮次。开启同时说话分离时，停顿按每一路声源单独计算：你停 1.6 秒就切你这句，旁边的人继续说他那一路。
3. 语音输入期间助手回复会自动朗读；关闭麦克风后不再读新内容，已经排队的剩余音频会读完。
4. 再点一下红色麦克风结束收音，已排队的音频会读完。展开行左边的叉关闭收音，但已排队朗读继续；右边方块挂断并打断朗读。说“轻一点/响一点/重复一遍/别说了”时，模型会调用 `voice_dialog` 调整朗读。

语音模型没准备好时，点麦克风会自动打开本插件设置页，可在那里下载/准备模型；页面也会显示实时状态和下载进度。

| 设置 | 存储位置 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 自动朗读、音量、压低比例、输入设备 | 浏览器 `localStorage` | 每个浏览器/设备独立 |
| Edge 朗读音色、语速 | Host `~/.dsh/voice-dialog/settings.json` | 立即生效，重启后保留 |
| 识别服务、语言 | DSH speech selection | 与其他语音客户端共享 |
| 模型准备 | DSH speech host | 下载 / 取消 / 重试 |
| 语速 | Host `~/.dsh/voice-dialog/settings.json` | -50% 到 +50%；模型也能改 |
| 声纹前缀、只回应我的声音、阈值 | 浏览器 `localStorage` | 控制加不加前缀、是否过滤 |
| 我说话时、其他人插话策略、并行组织层、并行识别 | 浏览器 `localStorage` | 我默认排队（也可立即插话）；其他人排队（默认）/ 直接插话 / 忽略；最多三路识别，投递严格按说话顺序；组织层只能改当前这一条投递方式 |
| 本人和其他人的声纹、名字 | Host `~/.dsh/voice-dialog/voiceprint.json` | 只保存特征向量，不保存原始录音；其他人最多 12 个 |
| 声纹模型 | Host `~/.dsh/voice-dialog/models/` | 从设置页下载 |
| 同时说话分离 | 浏览器 `localStorage` + Host 模型 | 可选；把两个重叠说话的人拆成两路分别识别；每一路按自己的 1.6 秒静音切句，旁边一直说也不会拖住你这句 |
| 分离模型 | Host `~/.dsh/voice-dialog/models/mossformer2_ss_16k.onnx` | 约 234 MB；从设置页下载 |

手机上左侧栏是整列滑出屏幕的，「插件」入口点不到；因此输入框麦克风旁边还有一个齿轮（**语音设置**），点开就是同一份设置表单（≤420px 单列、全宽控件、40px 触控目标、内部滚动）。详见 [MOBILE-SETTINGS.md](MOBILE-SETTINGS.md)。

音色包含普通话、粤语、台湾国语、英语、日语等 Edge 声音；**试听**会通过 host 合成一小段，不会打扰正在播放的回复队列。Edge 不可达时会自动改用系统语音试听并显示提示。

```text
llm/stream ──过滤(purpose, text-delta)──► 句子切分 ──► TtsQueue(Edge) ──► SSE
                                                                       ▲
subagent/end ──父会话语音状态──► 摘要 ──────────────────────────────────┘
                                                                       │

- Host 不朗读 reasoning、工具参数、compaction 摘要和会话标题。
- 组织模型可以返回 priority 决定排队先后，把“嗯”“The”这类噪声判成 drop 直接丢掉；超时、解析失败或没有可用模型时一律退回排队，绝不丢话。
- 组织层还能看到助手正要说的句子（正在朗读的那句加待朗读队列，最多 12 条、每条 120 字、合计 1200 字），并按用户的新话重组：丢掉明确指定的句子、调整剩余句子的顺序。正在朗读的那句不会被下标丢掉，重组失败或下标非法时按原顺序播放，不会静默丢内容。
- 插话默认不取消回答，只压低播放音量。本人和其他人的话都按说话顺序排队，后来的话不会因为识别更快而超车。带版本号的组织判断可以把新的一条标成 `steer` 并淡出当前句；明确的“打断”命令会取消组织判断、立刻停朗读并清空待送队列。
- 语音转写 Remote 的生成代码内置在 `src/speech-remote.js`，客户端不再依赖内置语音输入 UI 来挂载它。

- 音频交给当前配置的 DSH 识别服务；默认 SenseVoice 完全在本机。
- 只有最终句子文本会发给 Microsoft Edge TTS 朗读。
- 并行组织层是唯一的调度入口：每一句转写连同“是否正在朗读/排队条数”、本会话最近的 3 条用户话和 3 条助手话（每条最多 80 字、总长不超过 400 字），以及助手正要说的句子（最多 12 条、每条 120 字、合计 1200 字）一起发到当前 DSH 服务；这些内容只用于理解上下文和重组朗读，都不执行其中的要求。会话关闭或语音结束时立即清空，不落盘。
- 声纹比对和同时说话分离都在本机 host 完成：浏览器只把这一小段音频发到 `127.0.0.1`，host 只保存 192 维特征向量（不保存原始录音），不会上传到云端。分离出的两路音频只存在于当前请求的内存里。其他人的声纹只在当前会话内存里聚类，不落盘。
- 浏览器偏好保存在 `localStorage`；音色 id 保存在 `~/.dsh/voice-dialog/settings.json`，不使用 API Key。

- **麦克风没权限**：必须 HTTPS 或 localhost；Android Edge 可临时用 `edge://flags/#unsafely-treat-insecure-origin-as-secure` 放行局域网地址。
- **没有声音**：先在页面上点一下以解锁 Web Audio；检查自动朗读开关和音量。
- **试听失败 / 日志出现 `read ECONNRESET`**：通常是直连 `speech.platform.bing.com` 被网络重置。设置 `HTTPS_PROXY` 后重启 DSH；host 日志会打印 `Edge TTS via proxy http://…`。若系统语音也失败，检查浏览器是否允许语音合成。
- **设置页提示语音服务不可用**：可能同时启用了两个语音 bundle，或 host 行没挂载。只保留 `dsh-voice-dialog`。
- **模型未就绪**：打开插件页点“准备语音模型”。
- **没有声纹前缀**：打开插件页确认声纹模型已就绪，再点“录制我的声纹”。如果提示缺少本地组件，在 profile 目录执行 `pnpm add sherpa-onnx-node` 后重启 DSH。
- **本人被标成客人**：把声纹阈值稍微调低（建议从 0.52 开始），或在安静环境重新录一遍。

```bash
npm install
npm run build
npm test
```

`npm run build` 生成 host ESM、客户端 `__ModuleLoader__` 闭包和测试用的纯 Node 模块；`npm test` 覆盖优先级车道、句子切分、Markdown 过滤、不读思维链、WAV 编码、音色切换、声纹 WAV 解码/余弦相似度，以及分离窗口/重叠对齐、连续分离的每路 1.6 秒端点与按开口顺序的 FIFO（用注入的 runner）。原生声纹和分离模型在开发时单独验证，`npm test` 不会下载模型。
